title: CrossRev offline full-loop eval case manifest
description: One frozen repository, one pull request, and the arms to run against it. The manifest never names a private repository, record, or path: repo is a stand-in slug (owner/name), frozen_repo is a local bare repository built for the eval, and every SHA is content in that repository. tests/eval/run-loop.sh enforces this file with jq (there is no other validator); the shape below is kept in step with that enforcement by tests/eval/self-test.sh.

repo.description: Stand-in slug the legs see (for example acme/widget). A slug, never a path or URL.

frozen_repo.description: Local bare repository the runner copies fresh per case and arm. A throwaway fixture path, never a private checkout.

reviewer.description: Explicit model pin committed into every synthetic base revision. Never codex: tests/stub/codex is a tripwire that exits loudly instead of running.

trusted_user.description: Login the stand-in reports for gh api user and attributes stand-in writes to.

review_payloads.description: Stubbed reviewer answers, one per pass; the last repeats. __EVAL_HEAD__ and __EVAL_BASE__ are substituted with the head under review and the synthetic base revision before each review leg. Full mode only.

resolve_payload.description: Stubbed resolver answer ({blocked, commit_subject, summary, resolutions}).

resolve_edit.description: Shell snippet the resolver stub runs in the checkout to model the code change. Null means the resolver changes nothing.

real_findings.description: Findings transcribed from a real review run. Planted mode only; concatenated with planted_findings into the one review marker.

planted_findings.description: Synthetic findings. Planted mode only. Each carries id (16 hex characters), path, line, side, severity, category, pre_existing, title, why, fix.
